scope: Updates install again, quickly and without blaming your other programs.

topics.title: Updates you can hear
details: While an update gets ready, you hear Closing Voice Companion. Please wait.
If you open it during an update, it tells you and closes again.

topics.title: Updates
details: Updates no longer stop after they download. They go on to install.
An update now gets ready in seconds.
Voice Companion no longer says another program is using its files when it is its own files.
If the update voice is missing, Windows reads the progress, and the update still installs.
